chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ali ibn Uqba, from Ayoub ibn Rashid, who said:
I heard Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) saying: The one who withholds the Zakat will be collared with a bald snake, and it will eat from his brain.
And that is His Word, the Mighty and Majestic: 'They shall have what they were niggardly of to cleave to their necks on the Day of Judgement.'

key_terms.يُطَوَّقُ: Will be collared/fastened around the neck

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for withholding Zakat according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) vividly illustrates the spiritual consequence of stinginess by linking the withholding of Zakat to a specific eschatological punishment: being collared with a bald snake that consumes the hoarder's brain. This imagery serves as a physical manifestation of the Quranic promise that one's own wealth will become a burden, emphasizing that the withheld alms actively torment the owner in the Hereafter.
